settings.heading: Precision Essentials, Honestly Priced.
settings.description: Kartzo was established to cut through inflated retail markups and counterfeit uncertainty. We partner directly with verified component manufacturers to bring premium audio, smart wearables, lifestyle gear, and home goods directly to customers across India.
settings.values_sub: How we maintain product integrity and customer trust at scale.

settings.title: Direct Factory Sourcing
settings.description: Every item is sourced directly from original manufacturers, eliminating intermediary markups and guaranteeing genuine factory seals.

settings.title: 7-Day Doorstep Returns
settings.description: If your purchase fails to meet expectations or sustains shipping transit damage, our logistics courier will pick it up directly from your door.

settings.title: Pan-India Express Dispatch
settings.description: Orders are packed within 24 hours from regional fulfillment hubs in Mumbai and Delhi, reaching over 19,000 postal codes rapidly.
